lockedMove.speaker: William Lane Craig
lockedMove.excerpt: now it's obvious that to the universe exists where by the Universe I mean all of SpaceTime reality not just our observable portion of it it therefore follows that the Universe has an explanation of its existence but but what sort of explanation is it well it seems plausible that three if the universe has an explanation of its existence that explanation is an external Transcendent personal cause why because the cause must be greater than the universe think of the universe all of space and time so the cause of the universe must be beyond space space and time therefore it cannot be physical or
lockedMove.proposition: Because the universe exists contingently, its explanation must be an external, transcendent personal cause.
